findings.M01: No question may need a person or a drawing surface to grade: every shown-work item (proofs, derivations, explanations, divisions; 53) and every drawing item (50 graphs on a blank grid and 5 graphs with a written equation) is redesigned as multiple choice
findings.M02: S42-F1-Q2 asked for a cubic with a positive y-intercept that touches the x-axis at 3 and falls to the right; no cubic has all of these features (touching at 3 and falling to the right make it negative between -1 and 3). The condition is now a negative y-intercept.

rules: IDs of corrected questions are kept (status revised).
An ID whose skill or standard changes is retired and never reused; the replacement questions get new IDs (status new).
Sets added after publication take the next free set number; branches added to an existing set take the next free branch number. Numbers need not be consecutive.
